turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, am I speaking with Mr. Singh from Delhi?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, this is he. Who is calling?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I am Rohan from the Global Reach Agency, sir. I am calling because your profile was shortlisted for a home-based part-time rating project with very high daily payouts.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I am retired, beta. I do not know how to do these online things.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: That is the best part, Mr. Singh. It is very simple, just clicking a few buttons on your phone, and we provide full training.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: How much can one earn from this?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: You can easily make five thousand rupees a day. In fact, your account already shows a pending profit of eighty thousand rupees from the initial trial phase.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Eighty thousand? I did not do any trial. What is happening?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It was a pre-activation bonus, sir. To withdraw this amount to your bank, you just need to pay a small one-time security clearance fee of five thousand rupees.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Why should I pay money to get my own money?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It is for the government tax verification, Mr. Singh. Please send it via UPI now so I can release your funds immediately.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Let me ask my son first, I am not sure about this.
